title: Prophets
summary: Prophets spoke God’s word to His people and nations, often calling for covenant faithfulness, repentance, hope, and justice.
background: Prophets were not merely predictors of the future. They were covenant messengers who confronted sin, announced judgment, and proclaimed hope.
teachingHelp: When teaching prophets, identify the covenant issue, audience, warning, and hope rather than treating the passage as isolated prediction.
